description: 96 fictional labelled premise-to-conclusion cases: 24 supported, 24 unsupported, 24 contradicted, 24 without a qualifying explicit inference. Includes multiple premises, paragraph breaks, reported disagreement and uncertain conclusions. Hand-constructed smoke tests, not a measure of model generalisation.
